news.title: Global Power Grid Expansion Surges 50% to Record High
news.summary: Utilities built a total of over 21,000 km of new transmission lines last year, the International Renewable Energy Agency reported this week at COP31, citing data from a group called the Utilities for Net Zero Alliance. This is 50% more than the new transmission lines installed during the previous year, IRENA noted in its report. “Power grids will make or break not only the energy transition but also the world’s ambition to raise global electrification to 35% by 2035, as championed by the Turkish COP31 Presidency,” said the director-general…

news.title: Murphy Oil Draws Boycott Call Over Israeli Gas Licenses
news.summary: Pro-Palestinian activists who pressured Eni and Dana Petroleum to quit an Israeli offshore gas venture are now going after Murphy Oil, the Houston-based company that replaced them on Monday. The Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions movement and its partners called on Murphy on Wednesday to give up the six Zone G exploration licenses it holds 50-50 with Israel’s Ratio Energies. news.title: Who Will Buy Sable’s Oil if California Keeps Closing Refineries?
news.summary: Situated off California’s Santa Barbara coast, the Santa Ynez project operated by Sable Offshore has become a litmus test of President Trump’s determination to revive oil production in a state pursuing a future beyond it. After a decade of shutdowns, its return depended on the Trump administration’s intervention in a prolonged regulatory battle.
